tasks.title: Confound-breaking 2x2 (shard x transition regime) local-exponent factorial on fresh disjoint trial ranges, plus a null-object control on the 2-point local-exponent diagnostic itself

handoff.objective: PART A -- THE CONFOUND-BREAKING 2x2 FACTORIAL (new sampling). For EACH of shard 5000 and shard 8002 SEPARATELY (no cross-shard pooling anywhere in Part A), for each decode variant (unmodified decode_blocks, V3-defected wrapper), make EXACTLY ONE call to stage_a.py's real, unmodified _t_shard via matched_pair.py's run_arm with n_trials = 75000 -- never two or more separate calls for the analysis data, because a second call restarts trial indexing at 0 internally and silently re-derives an already-consumed domain. Four such analysis calls total: (5000, defected), (5000, undefected), (8002, defected), (8002, undefected). From each call's per-trial arrays, DISCARD indices [0:30000) from every statistic (computed, never skipped -- they carry the disjointness proof) and slice FOUR retained windows, IDENTICAL for both shards: P1 = [30000:35000) (T=5,000), P2 = [35000:45000) (T=10,000), N1 = [45000:55000) (T=10,000), N2 = [55000:75000) (T=20,000). START_INDEX=30000 is strictly above every previously consumed index on either shard (shard 5000: [0,15000) consumed by TASK-20260809-a79e4f stage 1 and TASK-20260814-8bbdd2; shard 8002: [0,30000) consumed by TASK-20260809-a79e4f stage 2 and TASK-20260815-e61cca), and is set EQUAL for both arms so that absolute trial-index position is common to both rather than confounded with which arm it is. The four windows are pairwise disjoint. Compute, per shard, using matched_pair.py's own arm_hists / evaluable_k / matched_pair_stats (imported read-only, NOT re-derived), at k=17 and at every k in 2..26 intersected with each window's own evaluable range: diff, se_paired, se_unpaired, unpaired/paired ratio, z_paired, z_unpaired. Then compute FOUR single-shard-only 2-point local exponents by the SAME alpha = -slope-of-OLS-on-2-points-in-log-log method TASK-20260814-8bbdd2 and TASK-20260815-e61cca used -- alpha = -[log(SE_hi) - log(SE_lo)] / [log(T_hi) - log(T_lo)]: alpha(5000, regime P) from P1->P2, alpha(5000, regime N) from N1->N2, alpha(8002, regime P) from P1->P2, alpha(8002, regime N) from N1->N2. Also report the three pre-registered contrasts on those four cells: regime main effect = mean(P cells) - mean(N cells); shard main effect = mean(5000 cells) - mean(8002 cells); interaction = (alpha(5000,P) - alpha(5000,N)) - (alpha(8002,P) - alpha(8002,N)). CITE, never recompute, the four historical cells (5000 regime P = 2.836 and 6000 regime P = 1.402 from EV-HQC-469c08 O6; 8001 regime N = -0.2682495157085447 and 8002 regime N = -0.8662355237627483 from EV-HQC-927899 O3-O4), and report alpha(5000, regime P) beside the historical 2.836 and alpha(8002, regime N) beside the historical -0.8662355237627483 as the family's FIRST fresh-range replications of an existing cell at the same (shard, regime). PART B -- THE NULL-OBJECT CONTROL ON THE DIAGNOSTIC ITSELF (no decoder calls). Build a decoder-free, shard-free, defect-free i.i.d. parametric null object: per-trial S drawn as the sum of n_e = 56 independent Bernoulli(p) block indicators, i.e. S ~ Binomial(56, p), with p calibrated ONCE before any ladder replicate by matching E[S] to the mean per-trial S of the real UNDEFECTED arm at T=10,000 (window P2 of shard 5000), then FROZEN in design.md and held fixed for every rung, every replicate and both arms. Both arms of every synthetic matched pair are drawn from the IDENTICAL law and differ only in RNG stream, so THREE quantities are forced analytically: log2 A_k = 0 exactly at every k (A_k = 1 is a theorem on the independent-block null), paired diff = 0 exactly at every k, and the 2-point local exponent alpha = 0.5 exactly (i.i.d. draws from one law give true paired SE proportional to T^(-1/2), so a 2-point log-log slope on exact SEs returns 0.5; the T^(-1/2) law is exact only asymptotically, with an O(T^(-1)) finite-T correction, which is why the ladder runs AT the same T values and batch sizes as the real arms instead of asserting 0.5 from theory). Feed the synthetic per-trial arrays through the SAME arm_hists / evaluable_k / log2_A_from_hists / matched_pair_stats / 2-point-OLS code path Part A uses -- the pipeline IS the object under test, so no part of it may be bypassed or reimplemented. Run the ladder at T in {5000, 10000, 20000, 40000} (batch sizes 25, 50, 100, 200; the adjacent pairs 5000->10000 and 10000->20000 ARE the two contested regimes exactly) with R = 200 independent replicates per rung, streaming one replicate at a time and accumulating only summary statistics. Report, per rung: the distribution of log2 A_k and its deviation from the forced 0; the distribution of paired diff and its deviation from the forced 0; and the distribution of se_paired. Report, per ADJACENT RUNG PAIR: the empirical distribution of the 2-point local exponent alpha (mean, SD, and the 2.5 / 50 / 97.5 percentiles over replicates) against the forced value 0.5. Report the four-rung full-ladder OLS exponent with its residual-based interval, which carries 2 residual degrees of freedom against the 2-point slope's zero, and the scatter of the 2-point estimates about it. PART B SENSITIVITY LEG (mandatory, anti-blindness). At the T=20,000 rung, additionally generate a DISPERSION-SCALED variant arm for each pre-registered g in {1.25, 1.5, 2.0}, MEASURE (never predict) the realized ratio rho_g = se_paired(planted, T=20000) / se_paired(unmodified, T=20000) over the same R replicates, and check the forced arithmetic identity that the 2-point local exponent from (T=10,000 unmodified -> T=20,000 planted) equals alpha_unmodified(10000->20000) - log2(rho_g), since log2(20000/10000) = 1; report the residual of that identity. Then report, for each g, whether the planted leg's replicate distribution of alpha lies OUTSIDE the unmodified null 95% band at that rung pair. OBSERVATIONS ONLY THROUGHOUT: report every number and every PASS/FAIL, and draw no conclusion about which explanation obtains, about HQC, or about what the campaign should do next.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the sign and magnitude of this family's single-shard-only 2-point local exponent track the SHARD or the TRIAL-COUNT/BATCH-SIZE TRANSITION REGIME -- currently indistinguishable, because the two are exactly collinear in all four measurements ever made and no shard has ever been run at the other pair's regime. And, separately and prior to it, whether that diagnostic can resolve anything at all: a two-point log-log slope has zero internal degrees of freedom and its sampling distribution has never been measured, so the null-object control establishes for the first time what value the diagnostic returns on an object whose answer is known analytically (0.5), how far it scatters around it at each batch size, whether that scatter is itself batch-size dependent on an object with no shards and no decoder, and whether a planted departure can be detected at all.
